sql: SELECT y.trip_date, MAX(CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.avg_total_amount END) AS target_avg_total_amount, AVG(CASE WHEN y.trip_date <> DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.avg_total_amount END) AS baseline_avg_total_amount, MAX(CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.trips END) AS target_trips, AVG(CASE WHEN y.trip_date <> DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.trips END) AS baseline_avg_trips, MAX(CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.avg_trip_distance END) AS target_avg_trip_distance, AVG(CASE WHEN y.trip_date <> DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.avg_trip_distance END) AS baseline_avg_trip_distance FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date WHERE d.d_dow = 1 AND y.trip_date IN (DATE '2025-01-06', DATE '2025-01-13', DATE '2025-01-20', DATE '2025-01-27') GROUP BY y.trip_date ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 500
